tests.runner_synthetic: synthetic formation: PASS; no real source opened

defect_corrected_before_real_run: Initial group ordering and volatility-balanced choice had opposite reversal direction; G5 now contains the lowest hot scores, with a signed fixture covering both selections. Amount window now checks trading status and permits suspended zero only.
second_review_corrections: Suspension, no opening quote, and a wholly missing source day are now stale or unfilled states, without automatic permanent basis lock. The next observed day checks price continuity against the most recent observed raw close.
Every held position with a valid opening quote updates its mark before order sizing; unknown close retains this mark even without rebalance.
The cross-activity comparison is explicitly low-activity increment minus high-activity increment, with a signed fixture.

The runner recomputes the frozen SHA-256 code selection from the 2595-code historical cohort after excluding the fixed old 600 codes, verifies the exact 300 selected codes against the acquisition contract and manifest, and records sparse opportunity coverage.
final_source_uncertainty_correction: Blank, nonpositive or invalid numeric fields and calendar gaps alone no longer permanently lock a holding. The closing mark remains unknown. Missing previous close or current preclose makes opening continuity unverified and blocks opening orders. Confirmed adjusted-preclose mismatch or mixed definite contradictions retain the permanent break.

real_run_gate.bindings: list of path/sha256 objects covering all frozen code, definitions and source references
real_run_gate.storage_plan: path/sha256 object for verified external output plan, at least 250 MiB estimated
real_run_gate.input_refs: path/sha256 object for input-refs.json, which must include acquisition_contract path/sha256

limitations: Daily opening prices are historical quote proxies, not actual order-book fills.
Factor arrival time is not established by this tool.
This implementation has no market-wide tradable-index excess return until separately bound reference data is qualified.
